description: This file defines the SensitiveDataMasker class used for masking sensitive information in nested data structures by pattern matching keys and string masking techniques.

classes.name: SensitiveDataMasker
classes.description: A class for masking sensitive data patterns within nested dictionaries, considering key names and applying partial masking to values.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] mask_dict( self, data: Dict[str, Any], depth: int = 0, max_depth: int = DEFAULT_MAX_RECURSE_DEPTH_SENSITIVE_DATA_MASKER, excluded_keys: Optional[Set[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Recursively masks sensitive data in a dictionary, respecting maximum depth.
